title: AMQP
html:
Enterprise messaging protocol. Producers publish to a broker; consumers pull from queues. Guaranteed delivery, async communication, service decoupling.

AMQP introduces a message broker between producer and consumer. Producers don't talk to consumers directly.

AMQP flow

Producer
Web services, payments
→ publish
Message broker
ExchangeQueuesRouting keys
consume →
Consumer
Order processing

Exchange types

Direct (1:1)

Message goes to exactly one queue. Used when one consumer should handle each message.

Fanout (1:N)

Message broadcast to all bound queues. Used for notifications every service needs.

Topic (pattern)

order.*.placed matches order.uk.placed. Flexible routing for complex event-driven systems.

Key benefit: Decouples producer from consumer. Messages wait in queue until consumed. Dead letter queues capture failed messages for retry.
